xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4697: test:frontend-subset is one 7.4 KB line in package.json, so every pair of PRs adding frontend tests conflicts; move it to a union-merged list file

plan.title: test:frontend-subset is one 7.4 KB line in package.json, so every pair of PRs adding frontend tests conflicts; move it to a union-merged list file
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: package.json line 141 holds test:frontend-subset as one 7,431-character line listing 126 frontend test files. Every PR that adds a frontend test appends to that line, so any two such PRs conflict; on 2026-11-01 five open PRs went CONFLICTING at once on it.
narratives.Proposal: Move the 126 paths into scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt (one per line, sorted, # comments allowed), add scripts/run-frontend-test-subset.mjs that reads the list, dedupes it and spawns the same npm --prefix ./src/dashboard/frontend run test -- <paths> command (with --dry-run and --list flags for tests), point the package.json script at the runner, mark the list merge=union in .gitattributes with a git merge-tree test and negative control, and update the three docs that point agents at the package.json line. Full detail in .pan/drafts/PAN-4697.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Running the whole frontend suite on CI (PAN-3532)
- Adding or removing any test from the subset
- Changing .github/workflows/ci.yml or src/dashboard/frontend/package.json
- A CI check that enforces sorted order or no duplicates in the list file
- The runner checking that listed files exist (the integrity test does that)
- Editing historical records under .pan/specs/, .pan/continues/, .pan/notes/, or evals/fixtures/
- Editing the operator's harness-native memory file
- Making GitHub mergeable honor merge=union, or a fallback for GitHub-only same-gap conflicts (PAN-4616)

autoDecisions.summary: The runner is a node script (scripts/run-frontend-test-subset.mjs), not inline $(grep ...) in package.json.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the scripts/*.mjs convention, avoids sh-only command substitution, and gives tests a behavior surface (--dry-run) that clears lint:source-introspection.

autoDecisions.summary: List paths stay relative to src/dashboard/frontend, committed in LC_ALL=C sort order; the runner dedupes and ignores order.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the spawned command identical to today; a union merge can leave lines unsorted or duplicated, so runtime must tolerate both.

autoDecisions.summary: The integrity test asserts only that every listed file exists; no order or duplicate assertion.
autoDecisions.rationale: A clean union merge can produce unsorted or duplicate lines; asserting on them would turn main red after a merge git reported clean. Existence catches the real defect (vitest silently ignores a stale path).

autoDecisions.summary: The merge proof is git merge-tree --write-tree in a temp repo whose worktree carries the real .gitattributes rule, plus a negative control without it.
autoDecisions.rationale: Probed with git 2.43.0 during planning: same-spot inserts merge cleanly with the rule (exit 0) and conflict without it (exit 1). merge-tree reads attributes from the worktree, which the test setup satisfies.

autoDecisions.summary: The operator's stale harness-native memory is flagged in the PR body, not edited.
autoDecisions.rationale: It lives outside the repo and managed sessions must not write harness-native memory.

autoDecisions.summary: Critique response: FR-4 is narrowed to local git merges; new FR-7 proves different-gap inserts merge cleanly with no merge driver; the GitHub-only same-gap conflict is a known limitation owned by PAN-4616.
autoDecisions.rationale: Planning probe: plain 3-way merge conflicts only on same-gap inserts. docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md already records the GitHub caveat and PAN-4616 (open) owns it. A live GitHub check would push throwaway PRs to the real repo.

items.title: Add scripts/run-frontend-test-subset.mjs that reads a list file and spawns the frontend vitest command

expected_outputs: run-frontend-test-subset.test.ts passes all five named tests

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 and Decision 6. Create scripts/run-frontend-test-subset.mjs (Node built-ins only): parse argv for --list <path> (resolved against cwd; default <repoRoot>/scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt) and --dry-run; forward every other arg after the paths. Read the list, trim each line, drop blank and #-prefixed lines, dedupe with first occurrence winning. Missing file -> stderr message naming the path, exit 1. Empty list -> stderr 'run-frontend-test-subset: <list path> lists no test files', exit 1. args = ['--prefix','./src/dashboard/frontend','run','test','--',...paths,...extra]. --dry-run prints JSON.stringify({command:'npm',args}) plus newline and exits 0. Otherwise spawnSync('npm', args, {cwd: repoRoot, stdio:'inherit', shell: process.platform==='win32'}) and exit with its status (1 if null). Write tests/unit/scripts/run-frontend-test-subset.test.ts that executes the runner with execFileSync('node', [runner, '--list', fixture, '--dry-run', ...]) against fixtures in mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(),'frontend-subset-')); never read the runner's source.

items.title: Given a list file with comment lines, blank lines and two paths, when the runner runs with --list <file> --dry-run, then it prints {"command":"npm","args":["--prefix","./src/dashboard/frontend","run","test","--",<path1>,<path2>]} and exits 0
Given a list that names the same path twice, when the runner runs with --dry-run, then args contains that path once
Given extra arguments such as --reporter=dot, when the runner runs with --dry-run, then args ends with those arguments after the paths
Given a list with only comments or a --list path that does not exist, when the runner runs, then it exits 1 and stderr names the list path
Create scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt with the 126 current paths sorted, plus an existence test

expected_outputs: frontend-test-subset-list.test.ts passes 'every listed frontend test file exists'
126 non-comment lines (or the current origin/main count)

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2. Generate the paths with node -e 'const s=require("./package.json").scripts["test:frontend-subset"].split(" ").slice(6);process.stdout.write(s.join("\n")+"\n")' | LC_ALL=C sort and write scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt as the six-line # header from the PRD followed by those sorted paths (no blank lines between paths). Do NOT edit package.json in this item. Write tests/unit/scripts/frontend-test-subset-list.test.ts that reads the real list via new URL('../../../scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt', import.meta.url), drops comment and blank lines, asserts the list is non-empty, and asserts expect(missing).toEqual([]) where missing = entries for which existsSync(src/dashboard/frontend/<entry>) is false. No order or duplicate assertion.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-3. Change only package.json's test:frontend-subset value to exactly "node scripts/run-frontend-test-subset.mjs". Leave "test" and .github/workflows/ci.yml unchanged. Before committing, git fetch origin main and run the PRD's equivalence script, which compares the command prefix and sorted path set of origin/main's package.json line with the runner's --dry-run output. If origin/main gained paths, add them to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt in sorted position and re-run. Paste the IDENTICAL line into the commit body. Do not run npm run test:frontend-subset or npm test on the host.

items.title: When package.json is parsed, scripts["test:frontend-subset"] returns exactly "node scripts/run-frontend-test-subset.mjs", and package.json no longer contains any of the 126 frontend test paths

Given origin/main's package.json, when the PRD equivalence script runs, then it prints 'IDENTICAL <n> paths' with n equal to origin/main's path count and exits 0, and the commit body records that line
git diff origin/main -- .github/workflows/ci.yml src/dashboard/frontend/package.json produces no output (CI still calls npm run test:frontend-subset)
Mark scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt merge=union in .gitattributes with merge-tree tests

expected_outputs: frontend-test-subset-merge.test.ts passes all four named tests

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-4. Append the four-line comment block and 'scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt merge=union' to .gitattributes after the concerns.md block (PAN-4614 style). Write tests/unit/scripts/frontend-test-subset-merge.test.ts with three tests: (1) git check-attr merge -- scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt at the repo root prints 'merge: union'; (2) in a mkdtempSync temp repo (git init -b main, user.email/user.name set), copy only the scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt line from the real .gitattributes into the temp .gitattributes, commit a base list (a.test.ts, c.test.ts), branch x inserts b1.test.ts between them and branch y inserts b2.test.ts at the same spot, keep the worktree on a branch that contains .gitattributes (merge-tree reads attributes from the worktree), run git merge-tree --write-tree x y and assert exit 0 and that git cat-file -p <tree>:scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt contains both b1.test.ts and b2.test.ts; (3) the same setup without .gitattributes makes git merge-tree exit 1. (4) FR-7: with no .gitattributes, base list a.test.ts c.test.ts e.test.ts, branch p inserts b.test.ts and branch q inserts d.test.ts (different gaps); git merge-tree --write-tree p q exits 0 and the merged list contains both lines. This proves the GitHub worst case (no union) still merges different-gap inserts. GitHub mergeable is out of scope (PAN-4616).

items.title: git check-attr merge -- scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt at the repo root prints 'scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt: merge: union'

Given two branches that each insert a different line at the same spot in the list, when git merge-tree --write-tree merges them with the repo's rule in .gitattributes, then it exits 0 and the merged list contains both lines
Given the same two branches with no .gitattributes, when git merge-tree --write-tree merges them, then it exits 1 (negative control)

Given no .gitattributes and two branches that insert lines into different gaps of the sorted list, when git merge-tree --write-tree merges them, then it exits 0 and the merged list contains both lines
Point the docs that name the package.json line or the union-merged files at scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt

metadata.sizeJustification: One small, inseparable change: 11 files, but the 8 subsystems are just the top-level homes of a list file, its runner, three test files, package.json, .gitattributes and four docs. Splitting into sibling issues would ship a list file nothing reads or a package.json pointing at a missing runner.
